title: I built a free directory where devs can find playtesters, and AI-assisted games are welcome
author: PlayTestBoard
selftext:
Hey all. I run PlaytestBoard ([playtestboard.com](https://playtestboard.com/)), a free site that lists open Steam playtests, demos and free browser games every day, so players can jump in and try new stuff.

Finding playtesters is the main point. If you've got a demo, a playtest or a browser build, you can submit it for free at [playtestboard.com/submit](https://playtestboard.com/submit) and it gets listed. No fee, no catch.

I'm also building a Made with AI section with two parts: one for games still looking for feedback, and one for games that are out now. It's opt-in, and the idea is to help people building this way get found, not to label anyone.

There's also a weekly community vote, Players' Pick of the Week, and the first one opens Monday, Nov 23: [playtestboard.com/vote](https://playtestboard.com/vote/)
